function Wg takes nothing returns nothing // Гриб нортренда
	local unit c
	set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)
	call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(Nv,gg_rct_MapArea,Ma)
	set bj_groupRandomConsidered=0
	set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=null
	call ForGroup(Nv,function GroupPickRandomUnitEnum)
	if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick==null or Rd(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick))then
		return
	endif
	set c=CreateUnit(Bv,'e008',GetUnitX(Hv),GetUnitY(Hv),.0)
	call UnitAddAbility(c,'A0AK')
	call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)
	call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D007F,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
	call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
	call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',10.)
	set c=null
endfunction

function Yg takes nothing returns nothing
local real x
local real y
local unit c
local fogmodifier vb
set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)
call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(Nv,gg_rct_MapArea,pa)
set bj_groupRandomConsidered=0
set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=null

if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick==null)then
return
endif
set x=GetUnitX(Hv)
set y=GetUnitY(Hv)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Naga\\NagaDeath\\NagaDeath.mdl",x,y))
set c=CreateUnit(Bv,'h04G',x,y,.0)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',20.)
if(Kr)then
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D000F,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
else
set vb=CreateFogModifierRadius(Bv,FOG_OF_WAR_VISIBLE,GetUnitX(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),GetUnitY(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),128.,true,false)
call FogModifierStart(vb)
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D000F,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
call TriggerSleepAction(.1)
call DestroyFogModifier(vb)
set vb=null
endif
set c=null
endfunction

handlers.body:
function Zg takes nothing returns nothing
local integer i=0
local real x
local real y
local real an
local unit u
local unit c
local integer vb
loop
exitwhen i>=Qa
set u=qa[i]
set an=GetUnitFacing(u)
set x=GetUnitX(u)+10.*Cos(an*bj_DEGTORAD)
if(x>=ta or x<=Sa or GetWidgetLife(u)<.405)then
call RemoveUnit(u)
set Qa=Qa-1
set qa[i]=qa[Qa]
else
set y=GetUnitY(u)+10.*Sin(an*bj_DEGTORAD)
if(y>=ua or y<=Ta)then
set y=GetUnitY(u)+30.*Sin((360.-an)*bj_DEGTORAD)
call SetUnitFacing(u,360.-an)
endif
call SetUnitX(u,x)
call SetUnitY(u,y)
set vb=GetUnitUserData(u)+1
if(vb>50)then
set vb=0
set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(u)
call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,x,y,700.,vr)
set bj_groupRandomConsidered=0
set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=null
call ForGroup(Nv,function GroupPickRandomUnitEnum)
if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick!=null)then
if(IsUnitType(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,UNIT_TYPE_FLYING))then
set c=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(Hv),'e008',GetUnitX(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),GetUnitY(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A082')
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D007F,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',2.)
else
set c=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(Hv),'e008',GetUnitX(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),GetUnitY(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A083')
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D007F,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',2.)
set c=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(Hv),'e008',GetUnitX(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),GetUnitY(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick),.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A04H')
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D00CB,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',16.)
endif
endif
endif
call SetUnitUserData(u,vb)
set i=i+1
endif
endloop
if(Qa==0)then
call PauseTimer(Pa)
endif
set u=null
set c=null
endfunction

local real y=GetUnitY(u)

local real an=ea[GetPlayerId(p)]*180.
local integer i=0

call SetUnitAnimation(u,"death")

set c=CreateUnit(p,'h08U',x,y,ModuloReal(an+GetRandomReal(-55.,55.)+360.,360.))
if(wr)then
call UnitRemoveAbility(c,'A080')

set qa[Qa]=c
set Qa=Qa+1
